Our waste matrix specifies that any batch at or above 1.0% chlorinated solvent must be routed to hazardous-liquid treatment rather than ordinary coolant recycling. I completed this analysis yesterday, but the result has not yet been formally attached to the waste authorization paperwork. This finding directly impacts the disposal route we should be approving today.
